prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: seamless repeating ground-material texture for an illustrated storybook website, square 1024x1024.
Primary request: Paint a flat, pale warm sandy footpath surface, to fill a winding trail and large text clearings in a whimsical gouache countryside illustration.
Input image: supplied near-bank grass texture is a STYLE reference only: match its handmade matte gouache brushwork, simplified shapes and paper grain. Do not include the grass or green from the reference.
Composition: orthographic flat material swatch, edge-to-edge. No perspective, no path shape, no border, no vignette. All edges must repeat seamlessly.
Palette: very light oatmeal cream #F2E8D2 with small quiet variations of ivory #F5EEDC and sandy beige #DFD0AD. Keep the overall tile pale and low contrast for dark green text placed over it.
Materials: fine paper grain, soft irregular horizontal dry-brush scumbles, sparse tiny sand specks and occasional small muted beige flecks. Texture should be visible but restrained, like sun-worn earth painted by hand.
Constraints: no outlines, no brown stripes, no cracks, no stones larger than tiny flecks, no grass, no vegetation, no text, no objects, no shadows, no lighting gradient, no watermark. This is a quiet uniform material, not a landscape illustration.
